# is-typedarray [![locked](http://example.invalid/stability-badges/dist/locked.svg)](http://example.invalid/badges/stability-badges)

Detect whether or not an object is a
[Typed Array](https://example.invalid/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Typed_arrays).

## Usage

[![NPM](https://example.invalid/npm/is-typedarray.png)](https://example.invalid/npm/is-typedarray/)

### isTypedArray(array)

Returns `true` when array is a Typed Array, and `false` when it is not.
